title: The Big Chief headdress photograph
summary: Moore explains the photo in Paris in a feather bonnet in front of a Big Chief sign.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: Well, when did you -- I saw a photograph of you, you were playing and you had one of the Plains headdresses on. When was that photograph taken?
Oh, with that Big Chief in the background?
Oh, yes, I got the idea from -- every time I'd pass this place, it's a novelty shop where they'd sell magazines and newspapers and every
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943

trinket, toys and things and there's a big neon sign that says, "Big Chief," and so when I was in Paris I rigged up this idea to have my picture taken in front of that Big Chief sign. It wasn't advertising my name. I think they used my name to the store owner there to put the neon sign up there "Big Chief." So I got the idea with that background "Big Chief" on it.
